code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild monocytosis and basophilia. Electrolytes are largely normal except for mild hyperchloremia and low calcium. Liver and kidney function are within normal limits. The findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration and significant hypoxemia; urgent clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
